# blitz-traits, Blitz main (be60597), unchanged

`packages/blitz-traits` of [DioxusLabs/blitz](https://github.com/dioxuslabs/blitz) main at commit
`be60597f67b3cece0456d26e8d7ff5a88600bbc5`, as `vendor/blitz-dom` (see its README.lightningpanda.md), which
needs this version. No local changes: `src/` is upstream's, and `Cargo.toml` is the package manifest with the
workspace's dependency versions written in. Drop it (and its `[patch.crates-io]` entry) once a Blitz release
carries these commits.
